transcript: Speaker A: कविता, आज मेरे बॉस आने वाले हैं। तुम किचन से बाहर मत निकलना। [Kavita, my boss is coming today. Don't come out of the kitchen.] Speaker B: ठीक है। [Okay.] Speaker A: Welcome sir, how was your journey? Speaker C: It was great Sunil. By the way, you have a nice home. Well done. Speaker A: Thank you, sir. Speaker B: Sir, have some water. What would you like? Tea or coffee? Speaker C: Coffee, please. Speaker A: कविता, तुम तो छा गई आज! इतनी अच्छी इंग्लिश! मुझे कभी नहीं बताया? [Kavita, you nailed it today! Such good English! You never told me?] Speaker B: आपको क्या लगता है, वाई-फाई सिर्फ सीरियल देखने के लिए आपने लगाया है? इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप। रोज़ 30 मिनट। जब आप ऑफिस जाते थे, एआई कोच से प्रैक्टिस करती थी। गलत बोलती थी, सुधार देता था। कभी जज नहीं किया, आपकी तरह। 3 महीने से प्रैक्टिस कर रही हूँ। [What do you think, did you install Wi-Fi just to watch serials? English Seekho app. 30 minutes daily. When you went to the office, I practiced with the AI coach. If I spoke incorrectly, it corrected me. It never judged, unlike you. I've been practicing for 3 months.] Speaker A: अब तुम्हें किचन में रहने की ज़रूरत नहीं। चलो, बॉस के साथ कॉफ़ी पीते हैं। [Now you don't need to stay in the kitchen. Come, let's have coffee with the boss.] Speaker B: उसने कहा था, किचन से बाहर मत निकलना। आज उसने खुद बोला, चलो बाहर चलो। अगर आपको भी किचन से बाहर रहना है और इज़्ज़त पानी है, ₹1 का ट्रायल आज ही। [He said, don't come out of the kitchen. Today he himself said, let's go outside. If you also want to stay out of the kitchen and earn respect, 1 rupee trial today.] Speaker D: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
summary: A husband tells his wife to stay in the kitchen during his boss's visit, but she earns respect by speaking fluent English. She attributes her skills to practicing 30 minutes daily with the English Seekho app's AI coach. The ad promotes a 1-rupee trial to help homemakers gain confidence and respect.
